title: Exposing and Mitigating Temporal Attack in Deepfake Video Detection
abstract: arXiv:2605.07398v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While spatiotemporal deepfake detectors achieve high AUC, our experiments reveal their susceptibility to evasion attacks. These models tend to overfit on fragile temporal spectrum cues, rather than learning robust semantic causality. To mitigate this vulnerability, we propose SpInShield, a temporal spectral-invariant defense framework explicitly designed to decouple semantic motion from manipulatable spectral artifacts. We propose a learnable spectral adversary that dynamically synthesizes severe spectral deformations, simulating extreme attack scenarios. By employing a shortcut suppression optimization strategy, SpInShield compels the encoder to extract reliable forensic cues while purging unstable spectral statistics from the latent space. Experiments show that SpInShield obtains competitive performance on widely used datasets and outperforms the strongest baseline by 21.30 percentage points in AUC under simulated amplitude s

translated_title: 揭示与缓解深度伪造视频检测中的时间攻击
translated_abstract: 尽管时空深度伪造检测器能够取得较高的AUC，但我们的实验揭示了这些模型容易受到规避攻击。它们往往在脆弱的时间频谱线索上过拟合，而非学习稳健的语义因果关系。为了缓解这一脆弱性，我们提出了SpInShield，一个时间频谱不变的防御框架，专门设计用于将语义运动与可操纵的频谱伪影解耦。我们提出了一种可学习的频谱对抗器，能够动态合成严重的频谱变形，以模拟极端攻击场景。通过采用捷径抑制优化策略，SpInShield迫使编码器提取可靠的取证线索，同时从潜在空间中清除不稳定的频谱统计特征。实验表明，SpInShield在广泛使用的数据集上取得了有竞争力的性能，并且在模拟幅度攻击下，其AUC比最强基线高出21.30个百分点。
tldr: 本文揭示了时空深度伪造检测器因过拟合脆弱的时间频谱线索而易受时间攻击的问题，并提出频谱不变防御框架SpInShield，通过可学习频谱对抗器与捷径抑制策略将语义运动与频谱伪影解耦，在模拟攻击下AUC比最强基线提升21.30个百分点。
en_tdlr: This paper exposes the vulnerability of spatiotemporal deepfake detectors to temporal attacks caused by overfitting fragile spectral cues, and proposes SpInShield, a temporal spectral-invariant defense framework with a learnable spectral adversary and shortcut suppression strategy that decouples semantic motion from spectral artifacts, outperforming the strongest baseline by 21.30 AUC percentage points under simulated attacks.
